question: The volume (in m³) of a cuboidal tank with dimensions 2 m × 11 m × 49 m is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of cuboidal tank = Length × Breadth × Height

Substitute values directly: 2 × 11 × 49 = 1078

**∴ Answer = 1078**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length = 2 m, Breadth = 11 m, Height = 49 m

**Formula used:**

Volume of cuboid = Length × Breadth × Height

 
• 
• 
• 
• Length = 2 m Breadth = 11 m Height = 49 m 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = 2 × 11 × 49

⇒ Volume = 1078 m³

**∴ The correct answer is 1078.**
